description: Run your own Data API query. Write the full GraphQL query yourself, so one step can read several models at once, and get the response data back as an object.
label: Data API Query

options.name: query
options.label: Query
options.info: The Data API query, e.g. query { allWebuser(take: 5) { results { id name } } allCompany { totalCount } }. Use {{name}} to insert a value from Variables. Without query { } around it, the step adds it.

options.name: variables
options.label: Variables
options.info: The values you can insert in the query with {{name}}. For text values add the quotes yourself: name: { eq: "{{name}}" }. Use {{{name}}} to insert text without escaping.

options.name: schema-model
options.label: Schema Model
options.info: Describes the shape of the response data, to type the fields of the Result. For a query like allWebuser { results { id } } the Result has the property allWebuser with the property results.

options.name: result
options.label: Result
options.info: The data of the Data API response: an object with one property per field in your query.
